name: Hell Bound
source:
When Angels are out to get you for being a descendant of the great Solomon, your only salvation lies with Demons. However, this newfound salvation comes at a price.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
当天使因你是伟大所罗门的后裔而出手抓捕你时，你唯一的救赎就在于恶魔。然而，这种新发现的救赎是有代价的。

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用程序[/url]]
